title: Deep Fried Dorito Bites

ingredients.item: Doritos chips, enough to make a batch

steps: Freeze the Doritos chips for 15-20 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pot.
Fry the frozen Doritos chips until golden brown.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
notes:
Make sure to freeze the Doritos before frying to achieve the best crispy texture.
